title: Autonomous Geo-SEO Engine & Schema.org JSON-LD Career Landing System (Dynamic Regional Hubs, llms.txt Crawler Indexation & Rich Search Snippets)
spec:
# DIR-024: Autonomous Geo-SEO Engine & Schema.org JSON-LD Career Landing System

## 1. Executive Context & Objectives (Opportunity Fix)
Organic candidate and recruiter acquisition in India requires strong regional and programmatic SEO. While the platform backend has `geoSeoSettings` and `llmGeoSettings` in MariaDB, the frontend has not yet exposed dynamic Indian city/state career hubs or structured `llms.txt` endpoints for modern AI-driven search engines (Perplexity, ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot).

This directive mandates a 10/10 implementation of an **Autonomous Geo-SEO & AI Search Engine**, introducing regional career hubs for major Indian tech clusters, automated Schema.org JSON-LD structured data injection, standardized `/llms.txt` crawler indexation, and dedicated Playwright E2E verification.

## 2. Key Architecture Directives
1. **Dynamic Regional Career Hubs**:
   - Routes: `/jobs/in/:state` and `/jobs/city/:cityName` (e.g. `/jobs/city/bengaluru`, `/jobs/city/hyderabad`, `/jobs/city/pune`, `/jobs/city/delhi-ncr`).
   - Dynamically filter MariaDB jobs matching the city, render a localized Cuba M3 hero ("Explore Top Software & Tech Jobs in Bengaluru"), display current active vacancies, average salary ranges in INR (₹ LPA), and top hiring companies.

2. **Automated Schema.org JSON-LD Structured Data**:
   - `RouteSeo.jsx`: Programmatically inject W3C/Google compliant JSON-LD `<script type="application/ld+json">` schemas:
     - `JobPosting`: title, description, hiringOrganization, jobLocation, baseSalary (currency: INR), datePosted, validThrough, employmentType.
     - `Organization`: name, url, logo, contactPoint, sameAs (social links).
     - `BreadcrumbList`: itemListElement reflecting current portal path hierarchy.
     - `FAQPage`: mainEntity with question and acceptedAnswer.

3. **High-Fidelity `/llms.txt` & AI Crawler Optimization**:
   - Serve `/llms.txt` and `/llms-full.txt` from backend or public route based on `llmGeoSettings` in MariaDB.
   - Format: Concise Markdown index outlining IME365 capabilities (AI Resume Builder with 51 templates, Audio Interview Coach, ATS Keyword Matcher, Digital Portfolios, Job Board).

4. **Dedicated Playwright E2E Verification**:
   - Author `playwright.dir024.config.js` targeting `tests/e2e/dir024-geo-seo.spec.js`.
   - Validate JSON-LD script presence, regional route filtering, `/llms.txt` HTTP 200 response, and canonical meta tags against the live stack with zero mocks.
invariants: INV-1: Frozen Baseline Integrity: git diff e314f715 -- src/cv-templates/ backend/services/aiRuntime.js must remain STRICTLY 0 bytes (57 CV templates + AI runtime frozen).
INV-2: Real MariaDB Job Data: Regional job counts and titles must be queried from authoritative MariaDB jobs table with zero synthetic mock jobs.
INV-3: Zero Insecure Script Injection: Schema JSON-LD must be serialized safely without allowing XSS injection via user-supplied job titles or descriptions.
INV-4: Mobile First Performance: Core Web Vitals (LCP < 2.0s, CLS < 0.05, FID < 50ms) maintained across all public SEO pages.
INV-5: Performance Budget: Server response time for /llms.txt < 50ms; bundle build < 4.0s.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-1: Dynamic Indian Regional Job Hubs: In src/components/JobsLanding/, support dynamic regional routes (/jobs/in/:state or /jobs/city/:cityName) that render tailored search landing pages for top Indian tech hubs (Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune, Mumbai, Delhi-NCR, Chennai) with localized salary benchmarks and active vacancy counts.

AC-2: Automated Schema.org JSON-LD Structured Data: In RouteSeo.jsx, inject validated JSON-LD schemas for: (a) JobPosting schema on job detail pages, (b) Organization schema on homepage, (c) BreadcrumbList schema on category pages, (d) FAQPage schema on FAQs. Validate with 0 Google Search Console warnings.

AC-3: High-Fidelity llms.txt & Markdown Summary Endpoints: Implement /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt endpoints (governed by llmGeoSettings in MariaDB) that provide clean, structured markdown summaries of platform capabilities, job listings, and career guides for AI crawlers (Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini).
AC-4: OpenGraph & Twitter Card Dynamic Previews: Generate dynamic SVG or optimized preview cards for public job postings and blog articles with company logo, job title, and salary tags.

AC-5: Dedicated Playwright E2E Suite (playwright.dir024.config.js & tests/e2e/dir024-geo-seo.spec.js): 100% passing tests against live dev server verifying JSON-LD injection, regional page rendering, /llms.txt content, and canonical link integrity.
AC-6: Quality Gates Pass: vite build < 4.0s, eslint 0 errors, npm test zero regressions.

evidence.summary: DIR-024 GREEN. Root-caused the lone failing E2E (rgba(0,0,0,0) first paint) to TWO real defects, both fixed. (1) DUPLICATE MAIN LANDMARK: RegionalJobsPage.jsx rendered its own nested <main> inside src/main.jsx's document-level <main id='main-content'>, violating the single-landmark contract in backend/test/p1-gap-source-contract.test.js and breaking axe landmark-no-duplicate-main; the spec's document.querySelector('main') resolved to the transparent outer main. Replaced all 3 branch <main> wrappers with <div>. (2) FIRST-PAINT FLASH: #main-content now paints the Cuba canvas inline via var(--cuba-canvas, #f4f5f9), matching the src/index.css fallback, so frame 0 is opaque instead of transparent while the lazy route chunk resolves. Live DOM probe on /jobs/city/hyderabad: mainCount=1, mainIds=['main-content'], firstMainBg=rgb(244,245,249), skipLinkTarget=true. Two further failures (sitemap.xml text/xml, llms.txt text/html) were proven STALE-SERVER artifacts, not code defects: the 15:16 run hit the previous Vite process; the current one (pid 15852, started 15:21) returns application/xml and text/plain correctly through the vite discoveryProxyPlugin. Also carried forward the WCAG fix on the hero eyebrow (text-cuba-primary -> text-cuba-primary-ink-strong, #7366ff 4.13:1 -> #4b3ec4 6.9:1), which is the AA-safe text token per cuba-tokens.css:55-59; I deliberately did NOT touch --cuba-primary since cuba-design-system.test.mjs asserts the brand violet stays below 4.5:1 for fills. EVIDENCE: Playwright 4/4 passed, 0 unexpected, 0 flaky (19422ms, live MariaDB, zero mocks); backend geo-regional 12/12; DIR-024+SEO unit 10/10; cuba-design-system+dir023-contrast+unlayered-css+four-portal 81/81; npm run test:security:static 67/67; p1-gap-source-contract 6/6; eslint 0 errors (only pre-existing warnings); vite build 3.86s (<4.0s budget); INV-1 git diff e314f715 -- src/cv-templates/ backend/services/aiRuntime.js = 0 BYTES; /llms.txt warm response 15.51ms (<50ms INV-5). No mocks, no fabricated data, no frozen-baseline drift.
